basis: Lymphoma occupying the retina; lymphoma adds the infectious_immune mechanism axis.
Disorder of ocular alignment with medial deviation of one or both eyes.
Lysosomal storage; respiratory insufficiency 7/8, hepatic disease with jaundice 5/8; neurologic degeneration common in survivors. Splenic involvement omitted by cap.
Carcinoma in situ confined to the uterus; reproductive organs have no axis.
HHV8-associated inflammatory lymphoproliferative disease. Organomegaly alone does not establish hepatic damage; damaging lung involvement is not established at ≥30%.
Inherited widespread cutaneous lentigines, explicitly without noncutaneous abnormalities or oral involvement.
Autoimmune blistering disease; damaging oral erosions occur in >30% across the group, particularly its common vulgaris form. Other mucosal sites are less consistently affected.
Opioid substance dependence has no axis; overdose injury and infectious complications are separate conditions.
Defining obstructive airway disease and exocrine pancreatic insufficiency (80-99%). Hepatic abnormalities occur in 5-29%; secondary infections do not make CF an immune disorder.
Mitochondrial metabolic disorder; learning disability 9/9, strabismus 2/2, retinal/cataract disease 1/1 and chronic renal disease 1/1. Small denominators limit certainty.
Inherited complement deficiency causing susceptibility to recurrent bacterial infections; pneumonia and meningitis are separately diagnosed infections.
Urothelial carcinoma arising in the bladder; lymphoma-like describes morphology rather than lymphoma.
Microcephalic primordial dwarfism; microphthalmia and dental/oral developmental abnormalities reported in 1/1 each, with uncertain population frequency. Renal ectopia <30%.
Intellectual developmental disorder with central motor abnormalities; cardiac and structural ocular defects are reported only in some individuals.
Sarcoma arising in breast tissue; breast has no axis. Mesenchymal histology alone does not establish locomotor-system involvement.
Neuroendocrine tumor arising in the colon; neuroendocrine differentiation alone does not establish endocrine gland disease.
Inborn amino acid metabolism disorder; no additional organ damage is established across this metabolic grouping.
Isolated congenital loss of smell; smell belongs to the neurologic axis. No structural airway disease is specified.
Defined by infection with an arterivirid virus; no consistent target organ is specified.
Neoplasm located in the pharynx, explicitly included in the pulmonary axis.
Carcinoma arising in a salivary gland; salivary glands belong to the gastrointestinal axis.
Structural disease of the renal arteries; renal parenchymal damage is not established in ≥30% and is not required for diagnosis.
Congenital cortical and other brain malformations with seizures and developmental delay; nystagmus is occasional and does not establish ocular damage.
Cerebral perceptual recognition deficit; the visual processing impairment does not imply disease of the eye.
Defined by eyelid ptosis, strabismus and ectopic pupils; all are ocular abnormalities.
